title: thoa raya
intro: Thoa raya, commonly known as the "Thai jasmine," is a plant species in the Apocynaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including the treatment of fever, colds, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of the plant include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its potential in reducing stress and promoting overall well-being. Bioactive constituents of the Thoa raya plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal effects.
